sloka: यथा त्वया कृतम् कर्म भीरुणा लोक गर्हितम् ।तस्कर आचरितो मार्गो न एष वीर निषेवितः ॥३-५१-२९॥
transliteration: yathā tvayā kṛtam karma bhīruṇā loka garhitam ।taskara ācarito mārgo na eṣa vīra niṣevitaḥ ॥3-51-29॥

translations.english: Your cowardly action will be condemned by the whole world. The path you have chosen is the path of a thief and not of a hero.
